theory Management_Policy_Downgrade

begin

// Function signature and definition of the equational theory E

functions: fst/1, pair/2, pk/1, sign/2, snd/1, true/0, verify/3
equations:
    fst(<x.1, x.2>) = x.1,
    snd(<x.1, x.2>) = x.2,
    verify(sign(x.1, x.2), x.1, pk(x.2)) = true

restriction Unique:
  "∀ x #i #j. ((Unique( x ) @ #i) ∧ (Unique( x ) @ #j)) ⇒ (#i = #j)"
  // safety formula

  /*
  expanded formula:
  "∀ x #i #j. ((Unique( x ) @ #i) ∧ (Unique( x ) @ #j)) ⇒ (#i = #j)"
  */

rule (modulo E) Register_Admin:
   [ Fr( ~admin_id ), Fr( ~admin_sk ) ]
  --[ Admin_Registered( ~admin_id ), Unique( <'admin', ~admin_id> ) ]->
   [
   !AdminRole( ~admin_id, ~admin_sk ), !AdminPK( ~admin_id, pk(~admin_sk) ),
   Out( pk(~admin_sk) )
   ]

  /* has exactly the trivial AC variant */

rule (modulo E) Create_Policy:
   [ Fr( ~policy_id ) ]
  --[
  Policy_Created( $Env, ~policy_id, $security_level ),
  Policy_State_Set( $Env, ~policy_id, $security_level ),
  Unique( <'policy', ~policy_id> )
  ]->
   [ Policy( $Env, ~policy_id, $security_level ) ]

  /* has exactly the trivial AC variant */

rule (modulo E) Policy_Upgrade:
   [ Policy( $Env, policy_id, $old_level ) ]
  --[
  Policy_Upgraded( $Env, policy_id, $old_level, $new_level ),
  Policy_State_Set( $Env, policy_id, $new_level ),
  Security_Strengthened( $Env, $old_level, $new_level )
  ]->
   [ Policy( $Env, policy_id, $new_level ) ]

  // loop breaker: [0]
  /* has exactly the trivial AC variant */

rule (modulo E) Policy_Downgrade:
   [
   Policy( $Env, policy_id, $old_level ),
   In( sign(<'downgrade_ack', $Env, policy_id, $new_level, nonce>, admin_sk)
   ),
   !AdminPK( admin_id, pk(admin_sk) )
   ]
  --[
  Policy_Downgraded( $Env, policy_id, $old_level, $new_level ),
  Policy_State_Set( $Env, policy_id, $new_level ),
  Downgrade_Acknowledged( $Env, policy_id, nonce ),
  Downgrade_Verified( $Env, policy_id, admin_id ),
  Security_Weakened( $Env, $old_level, $new_level ),
  Unique( <'downgrade_use', nonce> )
  ]->
   [ Policy( $Env, policy_id, $new_level ) ]

  // loop breaker: [0]
  /* has exactly the trivial AC variant */

rule (modulo E) Admin_Generate_Ack:
   [ !AdminRole( admin_id, admin_sk ), Fr( ~nonce ) ]
  --[
  Admin_Ack_Generated( admin_id, $Env, $policy_id, $new_level, ~nonce ),
  Unique( <'ack', ~nonce> )
  ]->
   [
   Out( sign(<'downgrade_ack', $Env, $policy_id, $new_level, ~nonce>,
             admin_sk)
   )
   ]

  /* has exactly the trivial AC variant */

lemma policy_monotonicity:
  all-traces
  "∀ env pid old new #i.
    (Policy_Downgraded( env, pid, old, new ) @ #i) ⇒
    (∃ nonce #j.
      (Downgrade_Acknowledged( env, pid, nonce ) @ #j) ∧ (#j = #i))"

guarded formula characterizing all counter-examples:
"∃ env pid old new #i.
  (Policy_Downgraded( env, pid, old, new ) @ #i)
 ∧
  ∀ nonce #j.

lemma no_silent_downgrade:
  all-traces
  "∀ env old new #i.
    (Security_Weakened( env, old, new ) @ #i) ⇒

guarded formula characterizing all counter-examples:
"∃ env old new #i.
  (Security_Weakened( env, old, new ) @ #i)
 ∧

   (Admin_Ack_Generated( admin, env, pid, lvl, nonce ) @ #j)
  ⇒
   ¬(#j < #i)"
*/
by sorry

  all-traces
  "∀ admin env pid lvl nonce #i.
